## Research Question

What changes? Which synthetic scenario or user problem does it address?

## Reproduction

Seed, rules, scenario, fork tick, expected result:

For agent experiments: engine/prompt version, provider and exact model snapshot,
population, days, repeat seeds, budgets, reported usage and JSON submission file.
Separate recorded observations from author interpretation and limitations.
For reproduction contributions: original digest and submission link, replay or
fresh run, same settings or new seeds, all repeated observations, differences and
alternative explanations. See docs/REPRODUCTION.md. No code changes are required.
Never attach raw provider responses, private logs or credentials. Model provenance
is self-reported; replay alone does not prove which provider was used.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passed
- [ ] Keyboard and mobile portrait checked
- [ ] Pause, reset, fork and export checked
- [ ] No real-person data, production access or telemetry
- [ ] Any new files/dependencies/assets included in boundary and rights review
- [ ] Commit author uses a public username and noreply email
- [ ] Assumptions and limitations stated, without claims about real people
